commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to an anemic score of 28 and benchmark indices pressured by surging crude and heavy FII liquidation, William O'Neil's market direction discipline demands extreme capital preservation. Three out of four stocks inevitably track index weakness; forcing breakouts during distribution phases violates Jesse Livermore's cardinal rule of market timing. Stan Weinstein's Stage Analysis dictates deferring long exposure unless setups maintain pristine Stage 2 structure above rising 30-week averages. With our deterministic gate at WEAK, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate raising cash, honoring stops ruthlessly, and resisting the urge to anticipate breakouts until market breadth confirms sustained institutional accumulation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

ACE.technical: Trades comfortably above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, confirming Minervini Trend Template criteria. The structure shows a constructive 12.8% cup with a 5.6% handle forming a double bottom. Neckline pivot at 1269.27 exhibits overhead supply absorption with relative strength holding firm despite broad market distress.
ACE.fundamental: India's mobile crane leader (63% share) expanded Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin to 20.5% with PAT reaching ₹118.6 Cr. Robust capital efficiency with ROCE exceeding 25% and virtually zero debt, though FY26 quarterly EPS volatility prevents full CANSLIM qualification.
ACE.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 1188.57 stop level; severe market breadth headwinds can abort handle breakouts into heavy distribution.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: Maintains a multi-month uptrend above its 50 SMA and 200 SMA, but recently breached its 321.27 pivot and closed back below it. This false breakout represents a classic Livermore danger signal, indicating active institutional distribution into liquidity rather than sustained absorption.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Operates premier coastal gas and liquid storage terminals with operating margins above 70%, but net profit contracted year-over-year. Stretched valuations (>120x P/E) coupled with contracting quarterly earnings completely fail CANSLIM's 'C' parameter.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Violating the 290.68 stop confirms an actionable Stage 3 top failure; exit immediately on any failed re-test of the breakdown.

AETHER.technical: Demonstrates high relative strength near 52-week highs, holding above key moving averages with RSI 64 and positive MACD. A constructive double bottom base is maturing near the 1799.80 neckline, showing clean volatility contraction as volume recedes on pullbacks.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemical leader benefiting from high-margin contract manufacturing (CEM) scale-up. Q1 FY27 net profit rose 33.5% to ₹62.7 Cr on 27.2% revenue growth with 31% EBITDA margins. Negligible debt (0.18 D/E) and zero promoter pledge underpin structural quality.
AETHER.risk: Fails on a breakdown below 1670.91; high valuation multiple leaves the stock vulnerable to sharp re-rating if general market liquidity sours.

AHCL.technical: Cleared a 20-session consolidation to achieve fresh 52-week highs above 34.00, riding above its rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA. Momentum is elevated, but micro-cap volume dynamics make the breakout prone to high slippage during index liquidation.
AHCL.fundamental: API and pharmaceutical intermediate manufacturer experiencing sharp top-line momentum, with Q1 FY27 revenue up 163% to ₹87.6 Cr and PAT reaching ₹8.3 Cr. Modest leverage (D/E 0.35x), but volatile historical earnings keep CANSLIM qualification partial.
AHCL.risk: Strict stop at 29.38; micro-cap issues gap violently on volume evaporation during market-wide risk-off days.

AONELIQUID.technical: Exhibits linear NAV progression with zero volatility, tracking overnight repo yields rather than equity accumulation. The scanner's 20-day breakout signal is a mechanical false positive caused by daily accrual rather than Darvas box accumulation.
AONELIQUID.fundamental: Angel One Nifty 1D Rate Liquid ETF is a cash-equivalent debt instrument investing in TREPS and sovereign repos. It possesses zero commercial revenues, earnings per share, or operating metrics, rendering CANSLIM and SEPA frameworks entirely inapplicable.
AONELIQUID.risk: Not an equity risk vehicle; close position immediately to redeploy dry powder into true market leaders when breadth recovers.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructing the right-hand side of a double bottom base below the 953.70 pivot. The price trades securely above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA lines, displaying noticeable relative strength while headline indices suffer sustained distribution.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: High-tech security and green packaging manufacturer posted an explosive Q1 FY27 with revenue up 111% to ₹87.8 Cr and PAT rising 151% to ₹27.4 Cr. EBIT margins expanded to 41.4% with negative net debt and ROCE near 30%.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Pattern breaks down on a close below 856.75; do not chase before market direction confirms institutional support.
